This folder contains a browser bundle of `@huggingface/transformers` 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0) and ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0 development build (MIT). Their model weights are fetched from Hugging Face on first model preparation and browser-cached for later use. Whisper tiny is MIT licensed by OpenAI; the multilingual MiniLM model is published by Sentence Transformers under Apache-2.0. See the upstream package/model cards and notices for full terms.
